title: Listen and Choose a Response — Campus Life

questions.stem: The campus shuttle hasn't come in thirty minutes.

options.B: Let's just walk. It's only fifteen minutes from here.
options.C: The shuttle is blue and white.
options.D: Yes, it came a minute ago.

questions.explanation: Suggesting an alternative is a natural reply. The others repeat 'come' and 'thirty minutes', or contradict the complaint with 'Yes'.
